title: Special Executive Programme In Corporate Stewardship
description: The Special Executive Program in Corporate Stewardship aims to equip the learner with an understanding of a leader’s role in creating organizational values as a steward of the investors.
longDescription: The Special Executive Programme in Corporate Stewardship provides an in-depth exploration of the stewardship role within corporations, emphasizing values-driven leadership and sustainable governance. Participants will learn about the ecosystem of stewardship, international stewardship principles, and the evolving landscape of corporate responsibility.
courseDetails: This programme explores the role of corporate stewardship in modern organizations, highlighting how leadership can drive value creation and foster sustainable business practices. Key topics include the International Corporate Governance Network (ICGN)’s Global Stewardship Principles, the responsibilities of corporations within their legal frameworks, and the values that underpin stewardship governance. Through real-world examples, participants will understand how to align corporate strategies with ethical leadership and sustainable outcomes.
